title: US Navy destroyer left without working toilets, food service or AC for FOUR DAYS after losing power in sweltering South China Sea
text:
US Navy destroyer left without working toilets, food service or AC for FOUR DAYS after losing power in sweltering South China Sea"

"USS Benfold suffered generator failure on July 24, leaving its crew without basic amenities amid blistering heat — 7th Fleet spox confirms to CNN
